product.title: Louvre Museum Masterpieces Guided Tour with Reserved Access

description.text: Experience culture and art through the ages with a tour of Paris’ epic Louvre Museum (upgrade for a small-group or private experience). As you go, your guide will share stories about the artworks, and will discuss the museum's long history. Stops include Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel, Louvre Museum. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Arc de Triomphe du Carrousel, Louvre Museum that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
